message.content: Let me look at the git history to find the specific commit that introduced the vulnerability. The issue is 42479042. Let me check the recent commits and the diff related to the vulnerability. Let me look at the most recent commit "Ensure timely error report from bgzf_idx_push()".

content:
commit dd6f0b72c92591252bb77818663629cc1a129949 (HEAD -> develop)
Author: Rob Davies <rmd+git@sanger.ac.uk>
Date:   Tue Oct 8 14:09:16 2019 +0100

    Ensure timely error report from bgzf_idx_push()

    In multi-thread mode, make bgzf_idx_push() check that the index
    can store items in range beg..end so any failures can be reported
    immediately.

    To enable this, the range checking code is pulled out of
    hts_idx_push() and put into a new function hts_idx_check_range().
